newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish Riksbank meeting ends with no changes.
newsitem.headline: Swedish Riksbank meeting ends with no changes.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, held a board meeting on Thursday but made no changes to interest rates.
The financial market had not expected the Riksbank to make any moves.
The Riksbank last lowered its interest rate corridor on August 15 when it trimmed its deposit and lending rates to 4.75 percent and 6.25 percent respectively.
On Tuesday this week the Riksbank made its 19th cut this year to the repo rate, the central rate in its three tier system, trimming the repo by another 10 basis points to 5.15 percent.
